left_alone.name: The
left_alone.why: Retailer link says only the-for-women, so the retailer calls it 'The' too. The brand's other products are de-accented French words (Calypso Chevrefeuille), which makes 'Thé' (tea) likely - but no source confirms a Thé release, so it is NOT renamed. An English stopword as a product name is still a defect worth resolving from a better source.
